title: bheka.agent.heartbeat.v1
description: Emitted by bheka-gateway on each successful POST /agents/{agentId}/heartbeat. Not written to audit_log (high-frequency telemetry; see 009_API_SURFACE section 6 and section 14). Consumed by observability pipeline and OpenTelemetry metrics.

event_id.description: UUIDv7. De-duplicate consumers on this field.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC of the heartbeat receipt.

current_tier.description: Collection tier active on the agent at heartbeat time.

buffer_used_bytes.description: Bytes consumed by the local SQLCipher buffer at heartbeat time. Used for disk pressure monitoring.

agent_version.description: Human-readable version string (e.g. '1.2.3') reported by the agent binary.
